scope: Actual generic QEMU PC/SeaBIOS boot and DOS execution; not an IBM7690 emulator, target ROM POST, diagnostic-menu pass, or physical touchscreen run.
memory_caveat: 16MiB chosen to run modern SeaBIOS; target documented RAM is640KiB. An earlier640KiB SeaBIOS smoke stalled before video.
drives: One read-only floppy; no hard disk; display captured through QMP; commands entered through emulated keyboard.

scenarios.observed: PC DOS boot chain executes AUTOEXEC and SERVICES; stops at INCORRECT DIAGNOSTIC DISKETTE / IBM MODEL7690 gate.
IBM PC DOS3.20; 23visiblefiles;555008freebytes; valid ECHO OFF; expected SERVICES firmware refusal.
Actual DOS loads version3.02, reports touch panel absent and IBM mouse fallback, reaches prompt and runs VER.
Unpatched3.02 loads through DOS; real INT21 open POINT/read requested10bytes returns2bytes 30 0D (0 CR); client exits to prompt.

probe.source_asm:
bits 16
org 100h
start:
    mov dx,name
    mov ax,3d00h
    int 21h
    jc fail
    mov bx,ax
    mov dx,buffer
    mov cx,10
    mov ah,3fh
    int 21h
    jc fail
    push ax
    mov ah,3eh
    int 21h
    mov dx,heading
    mov ah,9
    int 21h
    pop cx
    push cx
    mov dx,buffer
    mov bx,1
    mov ah,40h
    int 21h
    mov dx,newline
    mov ah,9
    int 21h
    pop ax
    add al,'0'
    mov dl,al
    mov ah,2
    int 21h
    mov dx,ending
    mov ah,9
    int 21h
    mov ax,4c00h
    int 21h
fail:
    mov dx,error
    mov ah,9
    int 21h
    mov ax,4c01h
    int 21h
name db 'POINT',0
heading db 'DOS handle read from POINT: $'
newline db 13,10,'Returned byte count: $'
ending db 13,10,'POINT probe returned to DOS.',13,10,'$'
error db 'POINT open/read failed.',13,10,'$'
buffer times 10 db 0
probe.boundary: Idle IBM-mouse fallback only; no optical hardware and no active touch. Byte-count display in this disposable probe assumes a single decimal digit.

scenarios.observed: Boots to DOS date/time prompts; Enter retains current values; VER reports MS-DOS Version5.00. No AUTOEXEC or KQPW application automatically launched.

not_run: 7690 system ROM or C000 adapter ROM
SERVICES menu after successful identity gate
capture_format: Each capture basename names ANALYSIS/<name>.png and .txt. PNG is QMP screendump; text is80x25 CP437 from physicalB8000.
correction_during_smoke: Generated AUTOEXEC changed from @ECHO OFF (unsupported under PC DOS3.20, observed Bad command or file name) to ECHO OFF; rebuilt corrected variants reached prompt with no such error. Original LEDINST.BAT not modified.
